winConditions.title: Reduce Opponent's Life to 0
text: Each hero starts with a life total shown on their card. Deal enough damage to reduce the opponent's life to 0 and you win.
If both players' life totals are reduced to 0 simultaneously, the game is a draw.

winConditions.title: Concession
text: You may concede at any time. Announce your concession and you lose immediately.
